purpose: Large external read-only knowledge federation for self-heal diagnosis, not executable repair instructions

sources.name: OSV.dev open source vulnerability database
sources.use: Known affected dependency versions and security advisories; full dump or ecosystem partitions available; respect per-source licenses and withdrawn status

sources.name: GitHub Advisory Database
sources.use: Reviewed security advisories and affected package versions; de-duplicate by CVE/GHSA/OSV aliases

sources.name: Cloudflare error responses and troubleshooting
sources.use: Provider error codes and recommended diagnostics; preserve source link and respect documentation terms

sources.name: GitHub Actions official docs
sources.use: Workflows, job failures, permissions, runner issues, scheduling, branch protection

sources.name: Python documentation
sources.use: Versioned runtime exceptions and standard-library behavior; do not infer fix without local tests

sources.name: MDN Web Docs
sources.use: Browser JS, HTML, CSS, network and accessibility compatibility

sources.name: Relevant upstream GitHub issues and releases
sources.use: Version-specific regressions and community workarounds; rank below official docs and verified local tests

sources.name: Stack Overflow Q&A
sources.use: Candidate diagnosis only; do not import full answers without attribution/license compliance; never execute pasted commands
